title: SDL Tetris ported to the browser

changes: No source edits were needed: the upstream project already guards its main loop with __EMSCRIPTEN__ and calls emscripten_set_main_loop.
limits: Keyboard controls work when the canvas has focus (click it first).
Audio is not used by this game, so no audio path was exercised.
